// divguard:path agent/mapped.go

package agent

import (
	"bufio"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"time"
)

// upstream: agent/src/agent-loop.ts:DEFAULT_RETRY_DELAY_MS
const retryDelay = 2 * time.Second

// upstream: agent/src/agent-loop.ts:MAX_AGE
const maxAge = 7 * 24 * time.Hour

const maxBytes = 50 * 1024 // upstream: agent/src/agent-loop.ts:DEFAULT_MAX_BYTES

// queueLimit appears in agent/src/mapped.ts, which PORT_MAP maps here.
const queueLimit = 250

// pig divergence (D56): a recorded divergence allows its literal.
const heartbeat = 5 * time.Second

const maxSafeInteger = 1<<53 - 1

type level int

const (
	ThinkingOff level = iota
	ThinkingMax       = 6
)

func unboundedLines(body io.Reader) {
	reader := bufio.NewReaderSize(body, 64*1024)
	for {
		_, err := reader.ReadSlice('\n')
		if errors.Is(err, bufio.ErrBufferFull) {
			continue
		}
		return
	}
}

func convert(ms int, d time.Duration, body io.Reader) time.Duration {
	_, _ = io.Copy(io.Discard, io.LimitReader(body, 1<<16))
	start := time.Duration(ms) * time.Millisecond
	rounded := (d + 999*time.Millisecond) / time.Second
	_ = float64(d) / float64(time.Second)
	maxTurns := 0
	if maxTurns == 1 {
		return 0
	}
	return start + rounded + d.Round(time.Millisecond) + time.Duration(0)
}
